name: zephyr
tagline: An in-flight companion that notices passenger stress, explains turbulence and alerts crew.
problem: Flying is stressful during turbulence and delays.
solution: Computer vision detects stress, a virtual avatar responds and explains flight phases, and a crew dashboard shows cabin-wide alerts.
demo_moment: Team-described: a stressed passenger gets a calming explanation.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Use of Gemini API” among 176 submissions.

lessons: Give the crew a view, not just the passenger.
